episodeTitle.en: The essence of product management | Christian Idiodi (SVPG)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品管理的精髓 | 克里斯蒂安·伊多迪（SVPG）

guestBioOfficial.en: Christian Idiodi is a partner at Silicon Valley Product Group. After a long product career and founding multiple companies, Christian now spends his time working closely with product leaders at companies big and small to implement and improve their discipline of product management. In today’s episode, we discuss: • Why there’s often a negative perception of product managers, and how we can fix this
guestBioOfficial.zh: 克里斯蒂安·伊多迪（Christian Idiodi）是硅谷产品集团（Silicon Valley Product Group）的合伙人。经过漫长的产品职业生涯并创立多家公司后，克里斯蒂安现在致力于与大大小小的公司产品负责人密切合作，实施并改进他们的产品管理体系。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• 为何产品经理常被负面看待，以及如何改变这一现状

title.en: The essence of product management | Christian Idiodi (SVPG)
title.zh: 产品管理的精髓 | 克里斯蒂安·伊多迪（SVPG）

summary.en: Christian reframes the essence of product management as waking up on behalf of someone else to solve a problem well enough that they give something back, and tackles why the field is so often disliked. He spends significant time on coaching—how to coach your reports and get better coaching from your manager—plus tactics for building trust with leaders. The conversation also shares his single favorite discovery method for figuring out what to build.
summary.zh: Christian 把产品管理的本质重新定义为“替别人醒来、把问题解决好到对方愿意回馈”，并探讨了该领域为何常被人嫌弃。他花大量时间讲教练——如何辅导下属、以及如何从经理那里得到更好的辅导——以及赢得领导者信任的战术。对话还分享了他最偏爱、用来判断“该造什么”的发现方法。
